about: Clarke's Coffee Shop has been a Cabra institution for over 19 years — famous for its breakfast roll, coffee slices, white bloomers and floury baps, all baked fresh in the adjacent bakery. Generous portions at affordable prices, with free Wi-Fi and the morning papers.
address: 52 Cabra Road, Cabra, Dublin 7, D07 A278
